cues: In the mesophyll, carbon dioxide is caught by a different enzyme, PEP carboxylase, which ignores oxygen completely.
It joins carbon dioxide to the three-carbon PEP, making oxaloacetate, a four-carbon acid.
That is why these are called C4 plants.
